body.name: Total full-label Airy procedure under contrast-weighted independence
body.construction: Draw the \(A_i\) independently with probabilities \(q^\star\). On positive-probability observations define \[T_i=\frac{c_{A_i}(Y_i^{\mathrm{obs}}-1/2)}{q_{A_i}^\star},\qquad U_i=\frac{g_{A_i}^\star(Y_i^{\mathrm{obs}}-1/2)}{q_{A_i}^\star},\] and \[\delta_n^\star=\operatorname{proj}_{[-1,1]}\!\left\{\frac1n\sum_{i=1}^nT_i-n^{-2/3}h_c\!\left(n^{-2/3}\sum_{i=1}^nU_i\right)\right\}.\] Return zero on null observations containing an inactive-arm label.
